description: Chintu the elephant is looking for his missing shoe in this fun, interactive kids song! Join Chintu and Mithu for a playful learning adventure. #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon
learning: Problem solving and spatial awareness for preschoolers.

scenes.text: Arrey! Chintu ka left shoe kahan gaya?
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up 3D render of Chintu the orange baby elephant with a blue scarf looking confused at his bare foot, bright sunny background, vertical 9:16, high quality CGI.

scenes.text: Mithu, help me find it, quick, quick, quick!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the green parrot with a red cap flying excitedly around Chintu, indoor playroom setting, colorful toys scattered, 3D animation style.

scenes.text: Bed ke neeche dekho, tap tap tap!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu looking under a colorful wooden bed, only his round bottom visible, funny perspective, vibrant room colors.

scenes.text: Not here, not there, hop hop hop!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu jumping over a pile of blocks, looking joyful, Mithu pointing a wing towards a pile of books.

scenes.text: Aha! Toy box ke peeche, peek-a-boo!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu pulling his blue shoe out from behind a large colorful toy box, wide grin, sparkling eyes.

scenes.text: Yay! Chintu ne pehna apna shoe!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu wearing his shiny shoe, doing a happy dance, confetti falling, bright lighting.

scenes.text: Chintu and Mithu are dancing with joy, haha!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu high-fiving, big celebratory expressions, colorful garden background, super cute 3D render.

scenes.text: Ruko! Ek aur shoe kho gaya, phir se dekho!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu looking back at the camera with a surprised face, one foot up, looping transition style, clean background.
